question: Which of the following is an example of multi-factor authentication for PC security?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Fingerprint scan**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• A **fingerprint scan** is an example of multi-factor authentication (MFA) used to enhance PC security.
 
• MFA requires two or more verification factors to gain access to a resource such as an application or online account, improving security by combining something you know (password) with something you have (security token) or something you are (biometric verification).
